note: Zone of R_harbour_02: the sandy cove below the jetty, camera on the beach facing the strait; landmark: the two ochre cliffs of the strait. Feminine LEFT: pirate pea paddling a dugout canoe (pirogue), gull pointing the way for the ducklings (navigation). nautique (adj): parrot in a sailor cap tying a knot on the upturned boat. Masculine RIGHT: little ferry with a red car through the strait (détroit), castaway sighing on the palm islet with coconuts (naufragé), explorer with a telescope at the prow (explorateur). Exit: stone steps near left -> up to the jetty R_harbour_02. Painted 2026-10-22.
